QuestInfo.name: Nestessary
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann needs help with something in the jungle. Go ask what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Spiegelmann needs help incubating a Manon's Egg he... procured. Go collect Cozy Feathers from the Rash in Peach Monkey Forest to make a nest.
QuestInfo.2: You made a nice nest for Manon's Egg!

0.0: This is tough work for a gentleman like-- What are you doing here?\r\n#L0##bOh, uh, I was... I was at your gallery and...#l\n#k
0.1: You're after my EGG aren't you?!\r\n#L0##bYou have an egg?#l\n#k
0.2: It's my egg! It's my precious. Nope. I can't let you take it. I birthed this from the bottom of Manon myself! \r\n#L0##bGross! I don't want that! I was at the gallery and I--#l\n#k
0.3: Gallery?! You're talking crazy! Now, if you're not here to steal my dragon egg, help me figure out how to hatch it so that I can rule this land with an iron moustache! \r\n#L0##b(He's clearly lost it...) Fine. What do you want?#l\n#k
0.4: I think this nest is all wrong. It needs something soft to cradle the little monster into hatching, right? That makes sense to me. I think it needs a cozy bed of feathers!

yes.0: Go to Peach Monkey Forest and pluck some Cozy Feathers from Rashes. I'll stay here and work on my dragon calls...

no.0: I knew it. You ARE after my egg! I will ward you off in the way of a mother dragon... KA-SQUAAAAWW!

1.0: Did you bring them? I need the feathers!

yes.0: This'll make a GREAT pillow for me to lay on while I watch the egg...

item.0: Go to Peach Monkey Forest and pluck some Cozy Feathers from Rashes.
